weapon_ability_description: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.
Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit.
The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.

While this model is leading a unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit. When this model is destroyed, each friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within 6" of this model must take a Battle-shock test.
The bearer has the Grenades keyword.
Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
Each time the bearer’s unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, ignore any vertical distance when determining the total distance the bearer can be moved during that move.

Once per battle, at the start of any phase, you can select one enemy unit within 3" of the bearer and roll one D6: on a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds, or 2D3 mortal wounds instead if it is a Vehicle unit.
Models in the bearer’s unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.
The bearer has the SMOKE keyword.
Each time you target the bearer’s unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.
In your Shooting phase, after the bearer’s unit has shot, the bearer’s unit can make a Normal move. If it does, until the end of the turn, the bearer’s unit is not eligible to declare a charge.
While a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is within 6" of the bearer, each time you target that unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.
The bearer has a 5+ invulnerable save.
The bearer has the Deep Strike ability.
The bearer has a Wounds characteristic of 6.
Add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in the bearer’s unit.
The bearer has a 5+ invulnerable save.
The bearer has a Wounds characteristic of 4.
The bearer has a Wounds characteristic of 6.

Models in the bearer’s unit have a 4+ invulnerable save. In addition, once per battle, in any phase, the bearer can summon a Watcher in the Dark. When it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer’s unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

Once per battle, in any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model in this unit, this unit can summon a Watcher in the Dark. When it does, until the end of the phase, models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds. Designer’s Note: Place a Watcher in the Dark token next to the unit, removing it when this ability has been used.
Models in the bearer's unit have a Leadership characteristic of 6+.
Add 1 to Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.
The bearer has the Feel No Pain 3+ ability against Psychic Attacks.
The bearer has the Feel No Pain 3+ ability against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.
The bearer has a Save characteristic of 3+.
Each time a model is destroyed by this weapon, you can select one friendly Plaguebearers unit within 12" of the bearer and return 1 destroyed Plaguebearer model to that unit."
While an enemy unit is within 6" of the bearer, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1.
Once per battle, when an attack is allocated to the bearer, you can change the Damage characteristic to 0.
Each time the bearer’s unit takes a Leadership test for the Dark Pacts ability, you can re-roll that test.
Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit (excluding CHARACTERS ) have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

If the bearer’s unit contains one or more Icons of Khorne, each time the bearer’s unit destroys an enemy unit, you gain 1 Bloodshed point. Each time you make a Blessings of Khorne roll, roll one additional D6 for each Bloodshed point you have, after which, all your Bloodshed points are lost.
Enemy units (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES ) cannot be targeted with Stratagems while they are within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit.
You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.
While the bearer’s unit is within range of one or more objective markers you control, improve the Leadership characteristic of models in the bearer’s unit by 1.
Add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in the bearer’s unit.
In your Command phase, if the bearer is not destroyed, you can return 1 destroyed model (excluding CHARACTERS ) to the bearer’s unit.
In your Command phase, if the bearer is not destroyed, you can return 1 destroyed model (excluding CHARACTERS ) to the bearer’s unit.

At the end of your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, if the bearer’s unit destroyed one or more enemy units that phase, the bearer’s unit takes a Leadership test. If that test is passed, you gain 1CP.
